EB Garamond, by Georg Duffner and Octavio Pardo, copied unmodified from
Google Fonts on 2026-09-20 (the file Google served for weight 600 was
byte for byte the 400 regular, so only the regular and the italic are
kept; the browser synthesizes the semibold the pages ask for):

  https://fonts.google.com/specimen/EB+Garamond
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ebgaramond

  eb-garamond-400-latin.woff2, -latin-ext.woff2         regular
  eb-garamond-400-italic-latin.woff2, -latin-ext.woff2  italic

Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, in OFL.txt beside this file.

Consumers: the reading face of the whole site (site.css sets it on the
body, the chips, the buttons and the card page), the tabular figures of
.num, the tick labels of the timeline (js/app.js) and the card page's
lifebar (js/card.js), and the italic capitals js/globe.js letters a
people's range in on the map.
